intent: Control Plane licensing (ADR-0026, licensing.md §8 option A): LICENSING_MODE=CONTROL_PLANE, CONTROL_PLANE_URL and OUTBOUND_HTTP_ALLOWLIST in the API environment, and CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN from the application bundle.
